segments.sn4.14:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati ekasālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme.
segments.sn4.14:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti.
segments.sn4.14:2.2: “ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti.
segments.sn4.14:2.3: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyā”ti.
segments.sn4.14:2.4: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn4.14:5.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugato”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.

lines: Mā sajjittho tadācaranti evaṃ dhammakathaṃ ācaranto mā laggi.
Dhammakathaṃ kathentassa hi ekacce sādhukāraṃ dadanti, tesu rāgo uppajjati.
Ekacce asakkaccaṃ suṇanti, tesu paṭigho uppajjati.
Yasmā ca hitānukampī, tasmā anurodhavirodhehi vippamutto tathāgatoti.
Tesu anurodhavirodhesu tannimittaṃ sajjati nāma saṅgaṃ karoti nāma, anurodhavirodhuppādanameva cettha sajjanaṃ.
Yadaññamanusāsatīti yaṃ aññesaṃ anusāsanaṃ, taṃ tesaṃ hitesanaṃ anukampanaṃ, tasmā anukampake hitesake sammāsambuddhe anurodhavirodhe āropetvā vikampanatthaṃ micchā vadasīti.
